newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Noyabrskneftegaz may pay only pref dividend.
newsitem.headline: Russia Noyabrskneftegaz may pay only pref dividend.

text.p: The board of directors of Noyabrskneftegaz oil company has recommended not paying out a 1996 dividend for ordinary shares, a spokesman for Noyabrsk holding company Sibneft said on Thursday.
The spokesman said 10.6 billion roubles, or 10 percent of net profit would be paid out in preferred share dividends. He did not say what net profit was in 1996.
Last year Noyabrsk paid a dividend of 661 roubles per preferred share with a face value of 200 roubles. It did not pay dividends on ordinary shares.

Sibneft holds a controlling 38 percent stake, or 51 percent of voting shares, in Noyabrskneftegaz, its main production unit. Previously unknown Finansovaya Neftyanaya Korporatsiya won a controversial tender this week for 51 percent of Sibneft.
